data_as_of: Yahoo Finance v7 quotes and v1 screener, ~11:30-11:50 a.m. CT Nov 11 (Russell 2000 and VIX ~11:30 a.m. CT). Prior closes are Tuesday Nov 10. Cash Treasury market closed for Veterans Day.
headline: Nasdaq-100 up 2.9% and chip stocks soar (SOXX +7.9%) as CoreWeave's raised outlook revives the AI trade; CoreWeave +26%, Micron +13%, Nvidia +4.6%.
drivers: CoreWeave's Q3 report after Tuesday's close set the tone: it raised its revenue outlook, expects about $9 billion in customer prepayments over three months and said it won't take on more expensive debt through 2027, easing worries about AI spending. CRWV is up ~26%, and the rally spread to neocloud peers (Nebius +19%), memory (Micron +13%, Sandisk +16%), optical names (Lumentum +15%, AAOI +19%) and AI servers (Dell +14%, Super Micro +12%). Nvidia is rebounding ~4.6% after two down days tied to the board's probe of CEO Jensen Huang, despite a Baird downgrade to Neutral. Stocks are open for Veterans Day, but the cash bond market is closed; yields jumped Tuesday after the hot October CPI, and Fed Governor Bowman said inflation is broadening. The VIX is down ~9% to 17.7, and Anthropic's IPO roadshow is under way at $70-$78 a share.
